dedupe_keys.name: freiburg permeable pavement soil moisture temperature and infiltration observations

description: The University of Freiburg publishes field observations beneath permeable pavements and urban green spaces to support urban water and energy studies. Version 2 contains soil moisture, soil temperature, dielectric permittivity, infiltration experiments, meteorological data and sensor or plot metadata, with site photographs. Coverage is within Freiburg, Germany, from November 2016 to October 2018. Most derived series are hourly, while selected observations have 10-minute or daily resolution. A modeller can use them to calibrate pavement drainage and urban heat simulations; the FluSM GMD paper explicitly identifies this archive as its model data. FreiDok provides a public ZIP bundle of documented tables and images, free for reuse under CC BY-NC 4.0, which excludes commercial use without separate permission. A limitation is that the pavement sample consists of impermeable pavers with permeable joints; porous asphalt and porous concrete are excluded. Version 2 corrects metadata and adds uncertainty information. FluSM is a separate G5 draft; no directly related existing catalogue record was established. No observations were downloaded.
